subject: Implementation MAP draft & first-wave canary proposal — NebulaMed
messages:

Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@nebulamed.com>

Subject: Signed SOW and next steps — implementation approach

Camila and team,

We executed the SOW this morning — thanks for the quick turnaround. Priya and I started sketching the post-signature activities on our side and would like to align on a practical mutual action plan (MAP) that nests the implementation milestones. High-level asks from NebulaMed:

- A clear, date-bound plan that includes a small-scale canary (first-wave) traffic window so we can validate performance and data paths before full migration.
- Training schedule for ops and clinical users (we'll need role-based sessions).
- A migration cutover plan that minimizes downtime for our production environment (healthcare data retention constraints).
- Runbooks / rollback criteria for the canary.

Can you share a draft MAP with owners and success criteria? We prefer a canary in early December if plausible — ideally a two-week window to ramp to ~10% traffic.

Attached: signed_SOW_nebulamed.pdf (signed SOW)

Thanks,
Sam Walker
Director of Platform Engineering
NebulaMed

From: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: RE: Signed SOW and next steps — implementation approach

Sam — congrats on getting the SOW across the finish line. Attached is a first-pass MAP that embeds the implementation plan (timeline, owners, and acceptance criteria). Key items summarized below; please review and flag anything missing.

Summary (MAP draft v1):
1) Initiation (Week 0) — Kickoff & environment prep
   - Kickoff meeting: week of 11/30 (owner: Camila)
   - Credentials & test dataset provisioned (owner: NebulaMed: Priya)

2) First-wave canary (Week 1–2) — limited traffic validation
   - Target cohort: 5–10% of production traffic routed to Redwood; run for 10 business days (owner: Rishi)
   - Success criteria: latency P50 < 200ms, error rate < 0.5%, model-output QA pass on 95% of sampled prompts
   - Rollback triggers and procedure included in canary playbook

3) Migration (Week 3–4) — phased ramp and cutover
   - Data migration windows, schema validation, final cutover checklist (owner: NebulaMed/Redwood jointly)

4) Training & enablement (parallel)
   - Role-based sessions (Ops, Clinicians, Support) + recorded materials (owner: Marissa)
   - Acceptance: successful shadow-run signoff from two clinical users

5) Go-live support (Week 5)
   - 72-hour hypercare with on-call infra and CS rotation

Attachments: MAP_draft_v1.pdf (contains timeline, owners matrix, and gating checklist).

I added Rishi and Marissa to help with canary sizing and training. If early-December canary is your preference we can target a start on Mon 2026-12-06 — Rishi, Marissa: can you confirm feasibility?

Cheers,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

--
[Attachment: MAP_draft_v1.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)]

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-11-21T13:34:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Signed SOW and next steps — implementation approach

Thanks Camila — reviewing the MAP draft. Operational notes from my side:

- Canary sizing: 5–10% looks right for initial validation. Recommend a day-zero smoke test, then progressive ramp every 48 hours if KPIs are met.
- Routing: we'll apply smart routing so traffic can be toggled by percentage and by cohort (internal patient-matching IDs).
- Fallback: prepare a lighter-weight model variant for the canary so we can fail gracefully and limit cost/spike exposure.
- Metrics: we'll instrument token-level latency, per-request error class, and a sampling hook to send model outputs to NebulaMed QA for blind review.
- Runbook: attached is a short canary_playbook with rollback steps and escalation matrix.

I can own the canary window and on-call support for the first 72 hours of canary.

Rishi
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

--
[Attachment: canary_playbook.md (Markdown, 8 KB)]

Adding the enablement/training plan:

- Training split: 3 sessions (Ops deep-dive, Clinical workflows, Support troubleshooting). Each session = 90 minutes + 30-minute Q&A.
- Timeline: run enablement during Week 2 (overlapping with canary) to get early feedback.
- Materials: quick-start playbook, role cheat-sheets, escalation contacts, and recorded videos for reference.
- Acceptance criteria: two clinical users complete a shadow run with a checklist; Ops can perform a simulated rollback.

Attached is a draft training schedule (dates are placeholders; will align to confirmed canary start).
